terrainDescription.zh: 地形多樣：內陸高原（highveld）、德拉肯斯堡山脈、開普敦地中海型氣候、東岸亞熱帶
terrainDescription.en: Highly varied terrain: interior highveld plateau, the Drakensberg mountains, Mediterranean-climate Cape Town, and a subtropical east coast

plate.color: white front / yellow rear (varies by province), black text, 2-letter province code suffix (e.g. GP, WC, KZN)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: No strongly standardized or common bollard style — not a useful identifying clue in South Africa

utilityPole.transformerMount: 1–5 horizontal cross-arms with small white pin insulators ("bird poles"); traffic-light poles are typically painted yellow

historicalContext.zh: 語言/文化的高度多樣性源自班圖遷徙、荷蘭/英國殖民、以及種族隔離時期的歷史政策，11種官方語言在憲法中並列。
historicalContext.en: The high linguistic/cultural diversity stems from Bantu migrations, Dutch/British colonization, and apartheid-era policy history; all 11 languages are constitutionally co-official.

note.zh: 恩德貝勒族（Ndebele）的幾何彩繪房屋外牆是南非很獨特、辨識度高的「建築」而非服飾線索；祖魯串珠飾品多見於觀光/文化展演場合，日常街景較少見，不宜過度預期。
note.en: Ndebele geometric house-wall paintings are a distinctive, high-visibility *architectural* (not clothing) clue unique to South Africa. Zulu beadwork mainly appears at tourist/cultural events, not everyday street scenes — don't over-expect it.

culturalMarkers.caveat: This is architecture, not clothing — tag accordingly in the images[].tags taxonomy
